notes:
Summary:
- Company: mid-to-large financial services firm building unified search for client docs, contracts, and support transcripts. Heavy regulatory needs (EU/NA data residency).
- Primary goal: replace brittle keyword search + faceted DB with RAG pipeline (embeddings -> ANN candidate gen -> cross-encoder rerank -> answer synthesis).
- Scale targets: initial index 200M vectors, planning headroom to 1B over 24 months. Typical vector dim 1536 (open-embedding models and self-hosted encoders evaluated).
- Latency/throughput targets: p95 retrieval+rerank <= 200ms for single-query, sustained QPS 100 with spikes to 400. Cost sensitivity: target <$0.005 per query, preferred <$0.002.
- Vector DB preferences: Pinecone for managed features, pgvector for lower cost on large snapshot tables, Elastic for hybrid keyword + vector requirements, Weaviate flagged for schema/metadata needs. Client expects Redwood to support connectors to Pinecone, pgvector (Postgres), and Elastic.
Connector / integration requirements (client-specified):
  - Bulk ingest: multi-tenant bulk upsert with idempotency and backpressure handling (CSV/JSON/stream).
  - Incremental streaming: nearline updates for new transcripts (latency goal: index-visible < 30s for upserts).
  - Metadata filtering: per-query boolean filters, range facets, multi-value attributes (must be applied at ANN stage).
  - Hybrid search: ability to mix sparse keyword BM25 prefilter with dense ANN, and route candidates to cross-encoder reranker.
  - Rerank pipeline hooks: support streaming candidates -> cross-encoder on GPU; provide metrics for rerank latency and token cost.
  - Vector schema migration: support multiple dims and dynamic reindexing strategy (rebuild vs incremental re-encode).
  - Cost reporting: per-query cost breakdown (ingest + retrieval + rerank tokens) in Console.
  - Security/compliance: VPC peering options, KMS integration for envelope encryption, audit logs for all query texts, data residency controls (EU), SOC2 + ISO27001 compliance evidence.
POC plan (6 weeks):
  - Week 0: Kickoff, define evaluation queries and scoring metrics (MRR, recall@K, p95 latency, cost/query).
  - Week 1-2: Ingest two corpora (contracts ~10M docs, support transcripts ~1M), test Pinecone connector for ingest and filter ops.
  - Week 3: Implement pgvector ingest and compare latency/cost at medium scale (50M vectors).
  - Week 4: Run rerank experiments: cross-encoder on 50 candidates; measure rerank p95 and token costs.
  - Week 5: Stability & scale test (QPS 100 sustained), tune batching + caching via Redwood Optimize suggestions.
  - Week 6: Deliver report + recommendations; decision to proceed to Dedicated or Private.
Quotes and client color: "Must be able to show 200ms p95 on our typical queries, or we can't replace existing product." — Head of Search.
Open items / ask for Redwood:
- Provide connector perf matrix for Pinecone, pgvector, Elastic across 10M/50M/200M vectors (latency, memory, index size, bandwidth).
- Confirm upsert streaming SLA (target <30s) and observed p95 for real-time workloads.
- Sample security artefacts: SOC2 Type II report, ISO certs, KMS integration docs.
- Workload pricing model for rerank-heavy pipelines (how to estimate token + GPU cost).
Stakes: If POC meets latency + cost goals, likely 3-year Dedicated commitment (estimated ARR in range).
